name: Contrariness
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft. /2 levels)
Targets one creature /three levels, no two of which are more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 1 minute
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The subjects of the spell become belligerent and negative toward all around them (-10 penalty to all Diplomacy checks). They will disagree with everything said. In a crowded area, such as a bar, this could easily lead to combat.
